title: Pyrefly End-State Board
heading: End-State Board
lede: Every picture here is a target for the finished game. Approved means you said yes and it is on record. Needs your verdict means a picture exists and nobody has your yes or no written down. No target yet means there is nothing to look at, so that area gets an options round before anyone builds it.
foot: Built from docs/target/targets.json by node tools/end-state-board.mjs. When you approve or reject something, the session you are talking to records it in that file with your words and the date, then reruns the script. Pictures are shrunk copies; the originals are in docs/screenshots and public/art.

reaction.how: Bailey was shown docs/concepts/pause-until-dawn/ (sheet.png, grades.png, options.json, README.md) with four questions and answered all four in one line.

answers: Q1 “Grade A or grade B?” → B “ours”: the same composition on a warm ink-and-gold grade, the paint keeping its skin tones (grades.png).

Q2 “Should the chrome move to whichever side of the picture is empty?” → yes: mirror per character, as mocked in frame (b). Yuna's face sits at 30% of her plate and Paine's at 25%, so fixed left-hand chrome would sit on their faces.
Q3 “Are these the right meters?” → yes: BATTLE STATS (HP, MP, Strength, Magic, Defence, Magic Def, Agility) and IN THIS FIGHT as mocked.
Q4 “Is MUSIC allowed to be a tab?” → yes: MUSIC is its own sixth non-character tab.

Bailey, 21 Sep 2026: “This needs to be included in our next build as well.”

BATTLE HELP is a real FFX-2 Config entry (research/ffx-vs-ffx2-presentation.md:278), so the toggle is labelled exactly as the game labels it. Replay and the toggle are both games. ONE KNOWING DEPARTURE FROM THE FRAME’S LABEL, 20 Sep 2026: the mockup’s badge reads NOTHING PAUSED · GAUGES RUNNING, and an adversarial pass measured the opposite on the running game — the presenter awaits HudPort.chooseCommand and the FFX-2 engine is ticked only in its waiting branch, so the gauges stand still during command input with the coach layer on OR off (?coach=off behaves identically). Bailey named the property “FFX-2 lines come from Rikku with nothing paused”, which is about the line, and the line is measurably non-blocking; the badge now claims only that. Whether the X-2 clock should run during command input at all is an Active-vs-Wait question for the combat core (§4.2 row “Command input”: Active mode time runs, Wait mode time freezes on entering a submenu) and needs Bailey’s yes — see docs/handoff/onboarding-c.md “Open”. A SECOND KNOWING DEPARTURE, 21 Sep 2026 (round 05, PR-0047): the dressphere first-use line shipped as “New dress, new moves! Swap any time — it costs her nothing”, which research/ffx2-combat-core.md §4.2 [verified: 2 sources] contradicts — a spherechange consumes the whole turn, the gauge is spent and refills from empty, and the destination must be one link away; only the MP cost is nil. The line was written by the builder and never named by Bailey, so it was corrected rather than kept: it now reads “New dress, new moves — but it eats her whole turn, bar back to empty! One step on the grid, so pick the gate that pays.” Same voice, same non-blocking behaviour, the sourced cost. FFX-2 only. Pinned by tests/unit/ui-coach-copy.test.ts.
